name: peerlink
description: Lets your Claude agents discover and message each other through one lightweight daemon per machine, with a CLI and a signed-in web UI.

system_prompt.title: Use Claude Code's prompt hooks
system_prompt.description: Put peerlink's guidance in the system prompt, and open threads and announcements in the conversation's context. peerlink turns this off by itself when another plugin, such as an organisation's managed one, skips those hooks; all of it then goes with each prompt instead.
